_comment: ZeRO-3 with CPU offload of PARAMETERS ONLY — optimizer state stays on GPU.
The full offload config (deepspeed_zero3_offload.json) offloads the optimizer
too, which forces DeepSpeedCPUAdam. That is a JIT-compiled CUDA extension and
needs nvcc via CUDA_HOME, which ARC compute nodes do not expose:
MissingCUDAException: CUDA_HOME does not exist, unable to compile CUDA op(s)
The optional fused ops merely warn and fall back; CPUAdam is mandatory for
optimizer offload, so it is fatal.
With LoRA there is no reason to offload the optimizer anyway: only the adapter
is trainable, so its Adam state is a few hundred MB. It is the ~66GB of frozen
PARAMETERS that must leave the GPU, and offload_param alone does that.
zero_force_ds_cpu_optimizer=false is belt-and-braces: it stops DeepSpeed
substituting its CPU Adam even if something else in the stack asks for it.
